Please raise this feature request in Rich Discussions first for maintainer approval. In the meantime, you can define a custom `RegexHighlighter` with your own patterns; see the [custom highlighter docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
